Then, for any two points \(x_i\) and \(x_j\), the distance is \(|x_i - x_j|\). The number of pairs \((x_i, x_j)\) with \(1 < |x_i - x_j| \leq 2\) is the number of pairs where \(|x_i - x_j| = 2\).
